title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Supertramp's bright, buoyant “Breakfast in America” — a sun-drenched, self-aware singalong with a warm acoustic core and a big chorus that feels like a morning with nowhere to rush. It brings easy optimism and a touch of playful nostalgia to a Djembe set, and it is instantly recognizable to anyone who grew up on 1970s pop-rock radio.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Supertramp's bright, optimistic “Breakfast in America” joins the request catalog this week.
